description: Scrape free stock photos and videos from Pexels by keyword search, curated/popular feed, photographer portfolio, curated collection, exact photo ID, or similar/related photos.

collectionSlug.description: Pexels curated collection slug or full collection URL (mode=byCollection). Example: `aquatic-aesthetic-bw7dkse` or `https://www.pexels.com/collections/aquatic-aesthetic-bw7dkse/`.
collectionSlug.title: Collection slug or URL

maxDuration.description: Only return videos at most this many seconds long (videos only; ignored for photos). 0 disables the filter.
maxDuration.title: Maximum video duration (seconds)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of media records to return. NOTE: Pexels' own public search pagination resets to empty results past page 20 (confirmed live: page 20 returns real results, page 21+ returns 0 items regardless of the query), so a single search-style query reliably returns roughly 450 items even when far more matches exist and a higher value is requested here.
maxItems.title: Max items

mediaType.description: Which kind of media to return. For mode=search this selects between Pexels' separate photo-search and video-search pages (`all` is treated as `photos`). For mode=curated/byUser/byCollection, `all` returns both photos and videos as they naturally appear in the feed.
mediaType.title: Media type

minDuration.description: Only return videos at least this many seconds long (videos only; ignored for photos). 0 disables the filter.
minDuration.title: Minimum video duration (seconds)

minHeight.description: Only return media whose height is at least this many pixels. 0 disables the filter.
minHeight.title: Minimum height (px)

minWidth.description: Only return media whose width is at least this many pixels. 0 disables the filter.
minWidth.title: Minimum width (px)

enumTitles: Lookup photos by ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

peopleCount.description: Filter photo search results by how many people appear in them (mode=search, photos only).
peopleCount.title: Number of people

photoIds.description: Pexels photo IDs or full photo page URLs (mode=byPhotoId: look up these exact photos; mode=similarPhotos: find photos visually/topically similar to each of these). Example: `18872916` or `https://www.pexels.com/photo/18872916/`.
photoIds.title: Photo IDs or URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy. Pexels is generally reachable without a proxy; enable the free Automatic datacenter group only if you experience blocking.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for (mode=search). Example: `nature`, `city skyline`, `coffee`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

username.description: Pexels photographer handle or profile URL (mode=byUser). Example: `alex-ivanov-773258579` or `https://www.pexels.com/@alex-ivanov-773258579/`.
username.title: Photographer username

title: Pexels Stock Media Scraper Input
